cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
수사 솔플로 한 마리씩
15분째 잡고 있네요...
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic low-angle three-quarter shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on pure #FFFFFF background: left, Night Elf Priest (she/her) inside a glowing golden Power Word: Shield bubble sweating heavily as she casts golden-white Smite sparkles at one cute 2.5-head chibi SD bandit guard on the right. Minimal stone floor tiles with two more cute 2.5-head chibi SD bandit guards behind.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
드디어 남작 처치!
얼른 루팅부터 해야—
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder three-quarter view in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on pure #FFFFFF background: left, Night Elf Priest (she/her, staff stowed on back) leans forward with sparkling eyes reaching both empty hands happily toward a defeated cute 2.5-head chibi SD Baron boss lying dizzy with spiral eyes on the right, golden loot sparkles rising from a leather pouch on minimal stone tiles.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
어?! 시체가 사라졌어요!
위상 바뀌어서 풀리젠?!
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle wide shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on pure #FFFFFF background: a shimmering cyan-white phasing ripple sweeps the center as the fallen chibi Baron vanishes into thin air right beneath the empty outstretched hands of Night Elf Priest (she/her, staff stowed on back) freezing in wide-eyed panic. All around her, three cute 2.5-head chibi SD bandit guards and a full-HP cute 2.5-head chibi SD Baron instantly respawn with glowing eyes on minimal stone tiles.

Centered Dutch-tilt big bust-up close-up filling 80% of canvas height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on pure #FFFFFF background: Night Elf Priest (she/her) completely frozen with hollow blank eyes, pale shock lines, dark vertical gloom behind her, and a stiff trembling smile as tiny cute chibi SD bandit silhouettes glint inside her pupils.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
한 땀 한 땀 잡았는데!
진짜 이 겜 접을 거예요!!
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile comedic shot across a small rustic wooden tavern table in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on pure #FFFFFF background: left, Night Elf Priest (she/her, staff stowed on back) slams both fists onto the table with teary furious eyes. Right, Gnome Rogue (she/her, daggers sheathed) leans lazily on one elbow watching her with a teasing deadpan smirk.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
너무 느려서 위상도 지쳤네.
접기 전에 골드나 주고 가!
cuts.visual_prompt: Reverse over-the-shoulder shot across the wooden tavern table in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on pure #FFFFFF background: right, Gnome Rogue (she/her, daggers sheathed) calmly sips a wooden tavern mug with a smug grin while holding out her other open palm. Left, Night Elf Priest (she/her, staff stowed) freezes mid-rant with stunned dot eyes and a cold sweat drop.
